text.text1: Built Around Complexity, Not User Count

text.text: You pay only for your data complexity and operational scope — a setup fee to integrate your workflows, plus an ongoing fee to maintain them. Never a per-seat fee.
text.text1: You pay only for the data complexity and operational scope deployed for your business — a setup fee to connect your data and workflows, plus an ongoing fee to keep them running. Never a per-seat fee.

text.text: A few questions about your data and workflows is all it takes

items.question: How does Ketrik pricing work?
items.answer: You're paying for senior engineering judgment already built into the platform — the kind of validation and system design that normally takes months to hire for and build in-house — plus the work to connect it to your data and workflows specifically. Ongoing platform access starts from $2,000/month, which is 5–10x less than the cost of a single senior hire.

items.question: How are setup fees calculated?
items.answer: Setup is scoped to your project's size and complexity—how much data, how many workflows, and how much automation you want running from day one. Pricing is calculated transparently using standard market rates and computed daily rates for the required engineering effort.

items.question: Why doesn't building this in-house make sense?
items.answer: Hiring senior engineers takes months before anything reaches production, while quick 'vibe coding' alternatives inevitably introduce technical debt and unmaintainable code. In-house builds trap your team in ongoing maintenance overhead and infrastructure duplication rather than driving core business value.

items.question: Do we need our own engineers to maintain this?
items.answer: No, but you can if you want to. If you have engineers, they can build and maintain the workflows, metrics, and data connections themselves. If you don't, Ketrik does that work for you — not just to get set up, but on an ongoing basis as your data and workflows change.

items.question: Can Ketrik be deployed into our own customer cloud account?
items.answer: Yes. Ketrik can be deployed directly into your existing cloud environment—whether AWS, GCP, or Azure—ensuring your data stays within your security perimeter and compliance boundaries while still benefiting from our managed maintenance and AI agent infrastructure.
